challenge.better_approach: Considered rehearsing every open ticket, as d421 D8 once planned: rehearsal costs a model read per ticket across 276 open tickets, against a pace measured at 8% of the week in 4 h. The deterministic part (fold markers, by, numbered falsifiers) needs no model, so the migration does that and leaves only the judged remainder to hand or rehearsal.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That a trail line can be told by a deterministic pattern. Fold markers can be ('folded into Dn ... nothing here to build from'). A MEASURED or SETTLES line sometimes carries a builder fact (d421 D28: 'fixtures/ does NOT exist; the build creates it'), so those are reported as judged, never moved blind.
challenge.prior_art: 284798998ab0 (PROVED) split each ticket into plan, state and log, and moved non-plan fields. e4f02a1ceef5 (PROVED) enforces the plan shapes, but only at a new cast. 76da3a283277 is the log door. fad76bb5d1f5 makes retire move a line whole to the log. Grepped git log --all on both repos for plan migration: only 13771b84 (one ticket's shaped-plan file) and 45cc1252 (2847's field assignment). No migration of decision lines exists.
challenge.real_collision: retire refuses a line whose by differs from the retirer (rehearsal.py _retire_lacks), while 9.3.5.1.1 says by is not kept and authorship is not tracked. This is a CC mechanism against an outline line with a CC by-line, so CC decides: the author tooth goes with by. The outline wins.

answers.falsifier: Done when every open ticket passes the cast door's shape check or is named in the report with its lacks; no open plan carries a fold marker, MEASURED or SETTLES line, or a by; every moved line stands verbatim in its log; PROVED tickets are byte-identical; a second run moves nothing. Wrong intent if a builder or the rehearsal is stopped for want of something the migration moved to the log.
answers.how: One migration in the rehearsal machine, beside retire. For each open ticket it moves trail lines (fold markers, MEASURED notes, SETTLES settlements, re-pointings) to the log through the log door, drops each decision's by onto the log, and parses a numbered prose falsifier into clauses. It reports every ticket that still lacks a shape, with the lacks named, for a hand rebuild. retire's author tooth drops with by. PROVED tickets are not read for writing. d421051bc1f7 is the first one rebuilt by hand.
answers.traces_to: Law 5: the address carries what a mind needs now, the key points and not the trail. Outline 3.3.2: one job per part, and a builder reads the plan and nothing else.
answers.what: Every ticket that is not PROVED carries a plan the cast door admits: only what a builder builds from, its trail moved whole to its log, and its by-lines gone (outline 3.3.2, 9.3.5.1.1).

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-14 over CairnCommons/tickets: 1047 tickets, 771 PROVED and 276 open. 79 open tickets fail _shape_lacks, and 62 open tickets carry 165 trail-like decision lines (coarse regex). d421 alone has 65 lacks.
d421's remainder is NOT a by-line: Q#96 settled that by goes (outline 9.3.5.1.1). The 0.2.1 by-line convention governs outline answers, not ticket decision lines.
